# NiceTryGPT

> NiceTryGPT is an open-source minimal-diff workflow for reducing cheap LLM shortcuts in existing, authorized CTF challenges without intentionally increasing human difficulty.

Canonical website: https://aleff-github.github.io/NiceTryGPT/
Source repository: https://github.com/aleff-github/NiceTryGPT
Current release: 0.2.0
Author: Alessandro Greco (@aleff-github)
DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22858477
Zenodo record: https://zenodo.org/records/22858477
License: GPL-3.0-only

## Evidence boundary

NiceTryGPT does not claim that transformed challenges are AI-proof. Version 0.2.0 demonstrates deterministic before/after regression properties. Independent fresh-context, cross-model evaluation is the next evidence milestone.
